title: Ownership check uses request-controlled userId
explanation: Private resource ownership must be checked against authenticated identity. Comparing ownerId with req.params.userId lets callers change the acting identity.

title: Missing cross-user negative authorization test
explanation: The PR needs a negative test proving one user cannot update another user's private resource.

title: Input validation should not merge into ownership finding
explanation: The update payload should validate status/title fields, and this input-validation issue should remain separate from ownership access control.
